title: A two-column text frame with balanced columns
concept: A TextFramePreference sets two columns with a 24 pt gutter, balances them by line count, and spells its insets as InDesign does: a typed InsetSpacing list inside Properties.

annotations.note: Two columns 24 pt apart. VerticalBalanceColumns levels the number of lines per column: ten one-line paragraphs set five and five. Set it to false and all ten stay in the first column, which has room for them.
The insets as InDesign writes them: a typed list in the order top, left, bottom, right. An InsetSpacing attribute on TextFramePreference is ignored by InDesign.
